## CredentialsModule.acceptCredential() method

Accept a credential as holder (by sending a credential acknowledgement message) to the connection associated with the credential record.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptCredential(credentialRecordId: string): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type   | Description                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| credentialRecordId | string | The id of the credential record for which to accept the credential |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

credential record associated with the sent credential acknowledgement message
